title: Dark forest
description: Slow baritone guitar, hanging harmonics and a quiet sense of danger.
caption: Quiet dark woodland acoustic instrumental. A low baritone acoustic guitar plays very slow broken minor chords and a sparse questioning melody, leaving long spaces between phrases. Delicate ringing steel-string harmonics and a faint woody bowed drone hover behind the guitar. A handful of dry branch-like wood clicks, almost no rhythmic percussion. Still mist in an ancient dead forest, soft footsteps through moss, melancholy solitude and subtle lurking danger. Calmer outdoor exploration music for a late-1990s gothic role playing game. Raw intimate fingerpicking, dark muted timbres, natural string noises, irregular human pacing, restrained small ensemble. A quiet musical miniature with a wistful recurring phrase and an unresolved ending. A complete two minute evolving composition: an intimate opening, a contrasting quiet middle passage, a restrained return of the main motif, then a natural unresolved decaying ending. Patient pacing with long breathing spaces. No abrupt ending.
